falseFriends.availability: Use 'rendelkezésre állás' not 'elérhetőség' (personal reachability) — critical OEE distinction
falseFriends.station: 'Állomás' is acceptable; 'munkaállomás' more precise for production workstation
falseFriends.billion: Use 'milliárd' (10^9), not 'billió' (which means 10^12 in Hungarian long scale)

grammarNotes.caseSystem: 18 grammatical cases — nominative for labels: 'Rendelkezésre állás'
grammarNotes.vowelHarmony: All suffixes must obey vowel harmony. Back-vowel stems (a, á, o, ó, u, ú) take back-vowel suffixes (-ban, -ra, -ok). Front-vowel stems (e, é, i, í, ö, ő, ü, ű) take front-vowel suffixes (-ben, -re, -ek/-ök). Example: 'selejt' has front vowels → plural 'selejtEK' (not *selejtOK). 'műszak' has back vowels → 'műszakBAN' (not *műszakBEN).
grammarNotes.definiteArticle: 'A' (before consonants) / 'az' (before vowels). UI labels omit article.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In compound noun phrases, only the HEAD noun takes the plural suffix. The modifier stays in its singular possessive form. CORRECT: 'sebességveszteség okai' (speed-loss [sg] + reasons-its [pl]). WRONG: 'sebességveszteségek okai' (speed-losses [pl] + reasons). For hyphenated compounds like 'sebességveszteség-csoportok' (speed loss groups), the first element is inherently singular — correct by construction.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE is dominant. Full Hungarian term: 'teljes eszközhatékonyság' (TEH). German manufacturers standardized terminology.
industryContext.tehAcronym: TEH appears in literature but OEE used in software interfaces.
industryContext.dominantSectors: Automotive (Audi Győr, Mercedes-Benz Kecskemét, BMW Debrecen), electronics, food, pharma

commonMistakes: Using 'elérhetőség' instead of 'rendelkezésre állás' for OEE availability
Incorrect definite article: omitting 'a/az' in sentences or adding to labels
Splitting compound words: 'ciklus idő' instead of 'ciklusidő'

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'sebességveszteségek okai' (WRONG — modifier pluralized) instead of 'sebességveszteség okai' (CORRECT — modifier stays singular). The modifier names the category; only the head noun takes plural
notes: OEE is standard; TEH exists but not required. Strong German manufacturing influence. 18-case agglutinative system with vowel harmony. Formal 'Ön' required. P95 expansion ~1.87x.
